mapper.select: SELECT id, calendar_date, calendar_year, day_type, name, enabled, source, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_date = #{calendarDate} AND enabled = TRUE AND status = 'CONFIRMED' LIMIT 1
SELECT id, calendar_date, calendar_year, day_type, name, enabled, source, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, calendar_date, calendar_year, day_type, name, enabled, source, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_date = #{calendarDate} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, calendar_date, calendar_year, day_type, name, enabled, source, status, remark, create_time, update_time FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_year = #{calendarYear} ORDER BY calendar_date ASC, id ASC
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_year = #{calendarYear} AND (enabled = TRUE OR status = 'CONFIRMED')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ( SELECT calendar_date FROM attendance_holiday_calendar WHERE calendar_year = #{calendarYear} AND enabled = TRUE GROUP BY calendar_date HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ) duplicated
mapper.update: UPDATE attendance_holiday_calendar SET calendar_date = #{calendarDate}, calendar_year = #{calendarYear}, day_type = #{dayType}, name = #{name}, enabled = #{enabled}, source = #{source}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
